title: Talk Is Cheap, Show Me Your Colors: Low-Budget Consistency Auditing for Aggregated LLM Services

creators.name: He, Xiguan
creators.affiliation: College of Information, Yunnan University of Chinese Medicine

description:
Aggregated large language model (LLM) services expose declared model identifiers while abstracting the backend configurations that fulfill client requests. We present HuePrint, a lightweight black-box framework that audits brokered endpoint consistency via short structured color elicitation (#RRGGBB and R,G,B) and continuous geometric distribution comparison without requiring model weights or token probabilities.

Across 34,528 deduplicated live cloud responses spanning 56 endpoints and 12 backends (Datasets A–E and Studies S1–S4), HuePrint lowers 30-call-per-side equal error rates from 4.52–5.23% for a single-word battery to 0.94–1.00% on the development cohort and from 6.25–8.04% to 3.49–5.00% across 20 locked endpoints, reaching 0.00% at moderate depth. Continuous and multi-scale RGB distances halve shallow-census error vs. exact-hex divergence (5.36% vs. 10.71%), cut cross-provider error from 16.67% to 5.93%, retain 0.00% ranking error across three-week and cross-gateway checks where strict equality tests reject up to 42.86% of genuine pairs, and bound numerical perturbations.

This Zenodo record includes the complete preprint with supplementary material (HuePrint_Preprint.pdf, 28 pages), standalone main and supplementary PDFs, and a self-contained offline replication package (HuePrint_Replication_Package.zip) containing all 12 read-only JSONL response corpora, multilingual prompt batteries, statistical analysis scripts, unit tests, and SHA-256 integrity manifests.
